title: Insurance Claim Repairs Repair Class Schedule — Labor Ceilings and Structural Capabilities
content:
Every Insurance Claim Repairs repair order is held in one of six repair classes. This schedule sets, class by class, the labor-hours ceiling that bounds a non-structural repair and the structural, certified-procedure and aluminum-bay capabilities the class calls for.

## Schedule

| Repair class | Entry profile | Labor-hours ceiling | Structural operations allowed | Manufacturer-certified procedures by a certified technician | Isolated aluminum repair bay with dedicated tools |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Express Claim Repair | no structural operations; labor hours within the class labor-hours ceiling; vehicle drivable at drop-off | 10.0 hours | No | No | No |
| Standard Claim Repair | no structural operations; labor hours above the Express ceiling and within the class ceiling | 30.0 hours | No | No | No |
| Major Claim Repair | no structural operations; labor hours above the Standard ceiling | 0.0 (no ceiling) | No | No | No |
| Structural Claim Repair | structural operations; steel unibody or body-on-frame body structure | 0.0 (no ceiling) | Yes | No | No |
| Certified Structural Claim Repair | structural operations; mixed-material body structure | 0.0 (no ceiling) | Yes | Yes | No |
| Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair | structural operations; aluminum-intensive body structure | 0.0 (no ceiling) | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Terms used in the schedule

- **Labor-hours ceiling** — the highest estimated labor hours the class takes for a non-structural repair, in hours to one decimal place. A ceiling of 0.0 means the class has no ceiling.
- **Structural operations** — sectioning, frame or unibody pulls and welded structural panel replacement. Only the three structural classes may perform them.
- **Manufacturer-certified procedures** — the repair follows the manufacturer's certified procedures and is performed by a certified technician. Required in Certified Structural Claim Repair and Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair.
- **Isolated aluminum repair bay** — the work is done in a bay set apart for aluminum repair, with dedicated tools. Required only in Aluminum Certified Structural Claim Repair.

## Reading the ceilings (hypothetical estimates)

| Hypothetical non-structural estimate | Against the Express ceiling of 10.0 | Against the Standard ceiling of 30.0 |
|---|---|---|
| 10.0 labor hours | within | within |
| 10.1 labor hours | above | within |
| 30.0 labor hours | above | within |
| 30.1 labor hours | above | above |

A figure equal to a ceiling is within that ceiling; only a figure higher than the ceiling is above it.
